title: Juicy Flaky Greek Beans Gigantes Plaki
description: A traditional Greek dish featuring large beans in a flavorful tomato sauce, perfect for a nostalgic and satisfying meal. This recipe is Whole30-friendly and made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Rinse the gigantes beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the beans, then place them in a large pot with enough water to cover them.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the beans for 45 minutes, or until they are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, until it is fragrant.
Add the canned crushed tomatoes, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked gigantes beans to the skillet and stir to combine with the tomato sauce.
Transfer the bean mixture to a large serving dish and top with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the gigantes plaki hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
